Cognitive Science
(journal)
Cognitive Science
is a multidisciplinary
peer-reviewed
academic journal
published by
John Wiley & Sons
on behalf of the
Cognitive Science Society
. It was established in 1977 and covers all aspects of
cognitive science
.
